items.stem: Standard cost for material is 3 kg at $4 per kg per unit. Actual production used 3.2 kg per unit at $4 per kg. What type of variance arises?

options.rationale: Correct: using more material than standard (3.2 kg vs 3 kg) at standard price gives an adverse usage variance.
Price was at standard ($4), so there is no price variance.
More material than standard was used, so the usage variance is adverse, not favourable.

items.explanation: Correct: using more material than standard (3.2 kg vs 3 kg) at standard price gives an adverse usage variance.

items.stem: What is the main purpose of preparing a flexed budget for performance assessment?

options.text: To compare actual results with the budget restated at the actual level of activity
options.rationale: Correct: flexing restates the budget to the actual activity level so like is compared with like.

options.text: To set selling prices for the next year
options.rationale: Pricing is a separate decision, not the purpose of flexing a budget.
Flexing a budget does not calculate depreciation.

options.text: To prepare the statement of financial position
options.rationale: A flexed budget is a control tool, not a balance sheet.

items.explanation: Correct: flexing restates the budget to the actual activity level so like is compared with like.

items.stem: Select TWO costs that are relevant to a make-or-buy decision for a component.

options.text: The incremental variable cost of making the component in-house
options.rationale: Correct: the additional cost of making is relevant to the comparison.
Correct: the price of buying is relevant to the comparison.

options.text: Fixed overhead that will be incurred whether the component is made or bought
options.rationale: Unavoidable fixed overhead is irrelevant because it does not change with the decision.

options.text: Depreciation on a machine already owned
options.rationale: Sunk depreciation on an owned asset is not relevant.

options.text: Head-office rent apportioned to the department
options.rationale: Apportioned unavoidable overhead is not relevant.

items.explanation: Correct: the additional cost of making is relevant to the comparison.
